14 And this gospel of the kingdom shall be preached in all the world for a witness unto all nations; and then shall the end come. Matt 24:14 (KJV)

The gospel that is referred to here, is different than most churches teach in this day and time, as gospel means “good news”, and most churches are teaching the law, which is not good news. The gospel that Jesus is talking about is the extremely good news that He came to die for us and bring us back into relationship with the Father (Romans 10:1-13). Many believe that Jesus came to just forgive our sins so we wouldn’t go to hell, but He came to not only forgive us of our sins (John 3:16), but to give us everlasting life (John 17:3). The reason that God sent Jesus to earth is to bring us back into relationship with Him.

This verse is where Jesus was answering the question from the disciples, about when the end times would come, and the signs of the end times. Jesus is saying that the gospel (good news of our salvation) must be preached in all the world, to all nations, before the end comes, and He returns to rule the earth (Revelation 19:15). With all the satellites and Christian television channels reaching all the world in this day and time, we can be assured that the end times are real close. When we see all the end time signs, we are told to look up and rejoice (Luke 21:28), as our redemption draws nigh. All of us, who are born again, should look forward to the return of Jesus, as it will begin our eternal life of being with the Father and Jesus (Revelation 21:3). Praise God – I can hardly wait.
